resources.string: Checked once in Level %1$d, then beyond the program
Marks the day done without training. It earns no points or ranks.
Marks the whole level done without training. It earns no points or ranks.
Ranks: %1$s. Double-tap for how they work.
%1$s points. Double-tap for how points and ranks work.
How do points and ranks work?

• Every set you tick earns points: its reps times how hard the exercise is, from 1 (easy) to 5 (extreme). A hold earns a rep for every 3 seconds. Program days, repeats, ready workouts and your own workouts all count.

• An exercise counts once you've spent at least 30% of its planned time on it. Placement, Complete day and Complete level earn nothing.

• Each skill has five ranks, at 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30 sets at its target. A target is a working set with a rep or two left in you, not your max. On one-sided moves, your weaker side counts. A skill's page lists its targets.

• Every rank you reach adds 100 points times how hard the skill is: 100 for a push-up, 500 for a full planche.

• Harder counts for easier: a bigger set counts for the lower targets, and a set on a harder rung counts for the easier rungs of its ladder.

• A skill is a move you do on your own, from a dead hang to a one-arm handstand: 40 in all. Assisted, banded, supported and lowering-only versions are steps toward them and earn no rank.

• A hold counts from when the shape is set until it breaks. A rep starts still, goes through full range and never kicks or swings.

• Did more or fewer than planned? Tap "Did more or fewer?" under the set. Count only clean reps; a logged number counts up to twice the plan.

• The outline shows how hard a skill is, green to red. The shield shows its rank, from one band (Rank 1) to the winged star (Rank 5).
